items.q: The swept volume of an engine cylinder is 350 cm3 and its clearance volume is 45 cm3. Calculate the compression ratio.
items.s: Compression ratio = (swept + clearance)/clearance = (350 + 45)/45 = 8.78.

items.q: A tractor engine runs at 2200 revolutions per minute and has a stroke of 140 mm. Calculate the mean piston speed in m/s.
items.s: Mean piston speed = 2 x stroke x speed/60 = 2 x 0.14 x 2200/60 = 10.27 m/s.

items.q: An engine takes in 600 kg of air per hour and burns 45 kg of fuel in the same period. Calculate the air fuel ratio.
items.s: Air fuel ratio = mass of air/mass of fuel = 600/45 = 13.3.

items.q: A tractor wheel would cover 150 m in a given time if it rolled without slipping but it actually covers 126 m. Calculate the wheel slip in percent.
items.s: Slip = (theoretical distance - actual distance)/theoretical distance x 100 = (150 - 126)/150 x 100 = 16 percent.

items.q: A trailer of weight 25 kN runs on a soil whose coefficient of rolling resistance is 0.12. Calculate the rolling resistance in kN.
items.s: Rolling resistance = coefficient x weight = 0.12 x 25 = 3 kN.

items.q: An engine turning at 2000 revolutions per minute drives through a gear ratio of 4.5. Calculate the speed of the output shaft in revolutions per minute.
items.s: Output speed = engine speed/gear ratio = 2000/4.5 = 444.4 revolutions per minute.

items.q: A pulley of 25 cm diameter running at 900 revolutions per minute drives a pulley of 80 cm diameter by a belt. Calculate the speed of the driven pulley.
items.s: N2 = N1 x D1/D2 = 900 x 25/80 = 281.2 revolutions per minute.

items.q: The unit draft of a tillage implement is 10 kN per metre of width and the implement is 3.5 m wide. Calculate the total draft in kN.
items.s: Total draft = unit draft x width = 10 x 3.5 = 35 kN.

items.q: An implement 2.5 m wide is worked at a speed of 8 km/h. Calculate the theoretical field capacity in hectares per hour.
items.s: Theoretical field capacity = width x speed/10 = 2.5 x 8/10 = 2 ha/h.

items.q: A field of 36 hectares is to be worked by a machine whose effective field capacity is 2 ha/h. Calculate the time needed in hours.
items.s: Time = area/capacity = 36/2 = 18 hours.

items.q: A planter drops 50 seeds over a travelled distance of 3 m. Calculate the average number of seeds per metre of row.
items.s: Seeds per metre = number of seeds/distance = 50/3 = 16.7.

items.q: A threshing machine handles 36 tonnes of crop in 9 hours. Calculate its throughput in tonnes per hour.
items.s: Throughput = mass/time = 36/9 = 4 tonnes per hour.

items.q: A tractor costs 4500000 naira and is expected to have a salvage value of 400000 naira after 10 years. Calculate its annual depreciation by the straight line method in naira.
items.s: Depreciation = (cost - salvage value)/life = (4500000 - 400000)/10 = 410000 naira per year.

items.q: An engine has a compression ratio of 22 and a swept volume of 850 cm3. Calculate its clearance volume in cm3.
items.s: Clearance volume = swept volume/(compression ratio - 1) = 850/21 = 40.5 cm3.

items.q: A 4 cylinder four stroke engine has a bore of 90 mm and a stroke of 100 mm. Calculate its total piston displacement in litres.
items.s: One cylinder displaces 636.2 cm3, so 4 cylinders displace 4 x 636.2 = 2545 cm3 = 2.54 litres.

items.q: An engine develops a brake power of 90 kW at 2200 revolutions per minute. Calculate the torque it delivers in N m.
items.s: Torque = power x 60000/(2 x pi x speed) = 90 x 60000/(2 x pi x 2200) = 390.7 N m.

items.q: A four stroke engine of 3.5 litre displacement develops 75 kW at 2400 revolutions per minute. Calculate the brake mean effective pressure in kPa.
items.s: bmep = 120000 x power/(displacement x speed) = 120000 x 75/(3.5 x 2400) = 1071 kPa.

items.q: An engine uses 7.5 kg of fuel per hour, the fuel having a calorific value of 43 MJ/kg, and delivers 40 kW at the shaft. Calculate its brake thermal efficiency in percent.
items.s: Fuel power = 7.5 x 43/3.6 = 89.6 kW. Thermal efficiency = 40/89.6 x 100 = 44.7 percent.

items.q: A tractor engine consumes 21 kg of diesel per hour while delivering 60 kW at the shaft. Calculate the specific fuel consumption in kg/kWh.
items.s: Specific fuel consumption = fuel used per hour/power = 21/60 = 0.35 kg/kWh.

items.q: An engine burns 9.5 kg of fuel per hour and the calorific value of the fuel is 43 MJ/kg. Calculate the heat energy released per hour expressed as a power in kW.
items.s: Fuel power = mass per hour x calorific value/3.6 = 9.5 x 43/3.6 = 113.5 kW.

items.q: A tractor pulls an implement with a draft of 5.5 kN at a forward speed of 6 km/h. Calculate the drawbar power in kW.
items.s: Drawbar power = draft x speed/3.6 = 5.5 x 6/3.6 = 9.17 kW.

items.q: At a given setting a tractor delivers 26 kW at the drawbar while 35 kW reaches the driving wheels. Calculate the tractive efficiency in percent.
items.s: Tractive efficiency = drawbar power/wheel power x 100 = 26/35 x 100 = 74.3 percent.

items.q: The torque at the axle of a tractor wheel is 4200 N m and the rolling radius of the wheel is 0.75 m. Calculate the tractive force at the rim in N.
items.s: Tractive force = torque/radius = 4200/0.75 = 5600 N.

items.q: A drawbar pull of 10.5 kN must be developed on a soil where the coefficient of traction is 0.55. Calculate the vertical load needed on the driving wheels in kN.
items.s: Vertical load = pull/coefficient of traction = 10.5/0.55 = 19.09 kN.

items.q: A gearbox receives 150 N m of torque from the engine and has a reduction ratio of 4.5. Calculate the torque at the output shaft in N m, taking the drive as ideal.
items.s: Output torque = input torque x gear ratio = 150 x 4.5 = 675 N m.

items.q: A belt runs on a pulley of 0.5 m diameter turning at 800 revolutions per minute. Calculate the linear speed of the belt in m/s.
items.s: Belt speed = pi x diameter x speed/60 = pi x 0.5 x 800/60 = 20.94 m/s.

items.q: A plough requires a draft of 30 kN and is worked at 4.5 km/h. Calculate the power required to pull it in kW.
items.s: Draft power = draft x speed/3.6 = 30 x 4.5/3.6 = 37.5 kW.

items.q: An implement of width 1.5 m working at a depth of 0.22 m requires a draft of 7500 N. Calculate the specific draft in kPa.
items.s: Area of soil cut = 1.5 x 0.22 = 0.33 m2, so specific draft = 7500/0.33 = 22727 Pa = 22.73 kPa.

items.q: A machine of width 4 m works at 6 km/h and its field efficiency is 85 percent. Calculate the effective field capacity in hectares per hour.
items.s: Theoretical capacity = 4 x 6/10 = 2.4 ha/h, so effective capacity = 2.4 x 85/100 = 2.04 ha/h.

items.q: The theoretical field capacity of a machine is 2 ha/h while its effective field capacity is 1.5 ha/h. Calculate the field efficiency in percent.
items.s: Field efficiency = effective/theoretical x 100 = 1.5/2 x 100 = 75 percent.

items.q: A machine has an effective field capacity of 1.8 ha/h and works 9 hours in a day. Calculate the area it can cover in a day in hectares.
items.s: Area per day = capacity x hours = 1.8 x 9 = 16.2 hectares.

items.q: A tractor uses 21 litres of diesel per hour and works at an effective field capacity of 0.8 ha/h. Calculate the fuel consumption per hectare in litres.
items.s: Fuel per hectare = use per hour/capacity = 21/0.8 = 26.25 litres per hectare.

items.q: A crop is planted at a within row spacing of 15 cm with a row spacing of 75 cm. Calculate the plant population in plants per hectare.
items.s: Population = 100000000/(spacing x row spacing) = 100000000/(15 x 75) = 88889 plants per hectare.

items.q: A seed rate gives a population of 400000 plants per hectare and the thousand grain weight of the seed is 40 g. Calculate the mass of seed required per hectare in kg.
items.s: Seed mass = population x thousand grain weight/1000000 = 400000 x 40/1000000 = 16 kg per hectare.

items.q: A thresher delivers 2250 kg of separated grain from a crop that contains 2450 kg of grain in all. Calculate the threshing efficiency in percent.
items.s: Threshing efficiency = separated grain/total grain x 100 = 2250/2450 x 100 = 91.8 percent.

items.q: A combine harvester leaves 150 kg of grain per hectare on the ground while the total yield of the field is 4500 kg per hectare. Calculate the header loss in percent.
items.s: Header loss = grain lost/yield x 100 = 150/4500 x 100 = 3.33 percent.

items.q: The cleaning unit of a thresher passes 950 kg of clean grain out of a total output of 1200 kg of material. Calculate the cleaning efficiency in percent.
items.s: Cleaning efficiency = clean grain/total output x 100 = 950/1200 x 100 = 79.2 percent.

items.q: The threshing cylinder of a machine has a diameter of 450 mm and turns at 1000 revolutions per minute. Calculate the peripheral speed of the cylinder in m/s.
items.s: Peripheral speed = pi x diameter x speed/60 = pi x 0.45 x 1000/60 = 23.56 m/s.

items.q: A machine costs 2000000 naira, will be worth 400000 naira at the end of its life, and the rate of interest on capital is 14 percent. Calculate the average annual interest charge in naira.
items.s: Average investment = (2000000 + 400000)/2 = 1200000, so interest = 1200000 x 14/100 = 168000 naira per year.

items.q: The annual fixed cost of a machine is 240000 naira, it is used for 500 hours in the year and its variable cost is 750 naira per hour. Calculate the total cost per hour in naira.
items.s: Fixed cost per hour = 240000/500 = 480 naira, so total cost per hour = 480 + 750 = 1230 naira.

items.q: An operation costs 1800 naira per hour and the machine works at an effective field capacity of 1 ha/h. Calculate the cost of the operation per hectare in naira.
items.s: Cost per hectare = cost per hour/capacity = 1800/1 = 1800 naira.

items.q: A pump delivers 8 litres per second against a total head of 30 m with an efficiency of 65 percent. Calculate the power required to drive it in kW.
items.s: Power = 9.81 x discharge x head/(1000 x efficiency) = 9.81 x 8 x 30/(1000 x 0.65) = 3.62 kW.

items.q: A pump of 5.5 kW runs for 10 hours and electrical energy costs 30 naira per kWh. Calculate the cost of the energy used in naira.
items.s: Energy used = 5.5 x 10 = 55 kWh, so cost = 55 x 30 = 1650 naira.

items.q: A tractor engine cylinder has a bore of 85 mm and a piston stroke of 110 mm. Calculate the swept volume of one cylinder in cm3.
items.s: Swept volume = (pi/4) x bore^2 x stroke = (pi/4) x 8.5^2 x 11 = 624.2 cm3.

items.q: The swept volume of an engine cylinder is 600 cm3 and its clearance volume is 60 cm3. Calculate the compression ratio.
items.s: Compression ratio = (swept + clearance)/clearance = (600 + 60)/60 = 11.

items.q: A tractor engine runs at 1200 revolutions per minute and has a stroke of 110 mm. Calculate the mean piston speed in m/s.
items.s: Mean piston speed = 2 x stroke x speed/60 = 2 x 0.11 x 1200/60 = 4.4 m/s.

items.q: An engine takes in 720 kg of air per hour and burns 65 kg of fuel in the same period. Calculate the air fuel ratio.
items.s: Air fuel ratio = mass of air/mass of fuel = 720/65 = 11.1.

items.q: A tractor wheel would cover 180 m in a given time if it rolled without slipping but it actually covers 160 m. Calculate the wheel slip in percent.
items.s: Slip = (theoretical distance - actual distance)/theoretical distance x 100 = (180 - 160)/180 x 100 = 11.1 percent.

items.q: A trailer of weight 36 kN runs on a soil whose coefficient of rolling resistance is 0.1. Calculate the rolling resistance in kN.
items.s: Rolling resistance = coefficient x weight = 0.1 x 36 = 3.6 kN.

items.q: An engine turning at 2400 revolutions per minute drives through a gear ratio of 4.5. Calculate the speed of the output shaft in revolutions per minute.
items.s: Output speed = engine speed/gear ratio = 2400/4.5 = 533.3 revolutions per minute.

items.q: A pulley of 15 cm diameter running at 1440 revolutions per minute drives a pulley of 50 cm diameter by a belt. Calculate the speed of the driven pulley.
items.s: N2 = N1 x D1/D2 = 1440 x 15/50 = 432 revolutions per minute.

items.q: The unit draft of a tillage implement is 12 kN per metre of width and the implement is 2 m wide. Calculate the total draft in kN.
items.s: Total draft = unit draft x width = 12 x 2 = 24 kN.

items.q: An implement 2.5 m wide is worked at a speed of 9 km/h. Calculate the theoretical field capacity in hectares per hour.
items.s: Theoretical field capacity = width x speed/10 = 2.5 x 9/10 = 2.25 ha/h.

items.q: A field of 18 hectares is to be worked by a machine whose effective field capacity is 1.6 ha/h. Calculate the time needed in hours.
items.s: Time = area/capacity = 18/1.6 = 11.25 hours.

items.q: A planter drops 45 seeds over a travelled distance of 2.5 m. Calculate the average number of seeds per metre of row.
items.s: Seeds per metre = number of seeds/distance = 45/2.5 = 18.

items.q: A threshing machine handles 18 tonnes of crop in 5 hours. Calculate its throughput in tonnes per hour.
items.s: Throughput = mass/time = 18/5 = 3.6 tonnes per hour.

items.q: A tractor costs 1800000 naira and is expected to have a salvage value of 750000 naira after 12 years. Calculate its annual depreciation by the straight line method in naira.
items.s: Depreciation = (cost - salvage value)/life = (1800000 - 750000)/12 = 87500 naira per year.

items.q: An engine has a compression ratio of 18 and a swept volume of 680 cm3. Calculate its clearance volume in cm3.
items.s: Clearance volume = swept volume/(compression ratio - 1) = 680/17 = 40 cm3.

items.q: A 4 cylinder four stroke engine has a bore of 85 mm and a stroke of 115 mm. Calculate its total piston displacement in litres.
items.s: One cylinder displaces 652.6 cm3, so 4 cylinders displace 4 x 652.6 = 2610 cm3 = 2.61 litres.

items.q: An engine develops a brake power of 52 kW at 1400 revolutions per minute. Calculate the torque it delivers in N m.
items.s: Torque = power x 60000/(2 x pi x speed) = 52 x 60000/(2 x pi x 1400) = 354.7 N m.

items.q: Which of the following best describes clutch?
o: the gear arrangement that lets the two driving wheels turn at different speeds on a curve
a coupling that connects or disconnects the engine from the transmission
the part of a seeder that measures out seed at a steady rate
the area a machine would cover in unit time at full width and full speed without any stop
items.s: clutch: a coupling that connects or disconnects the engine from the transmission. The other options describe differential, metering mechanism, theoretical field capacity.

items.q: brake power may be defined as
o: the useful power measured at the output shaft of an engine
the letting out of a machine and its operator to another farmer for a fee
a machine that places individual seeds or vegetative material at a set spacing
the transmission of power between two pulleys by an endless flexible band
items.s: brake power: the useful power measured at the output shaft of an engine. The other options describe custom hire, planter, belt drive.

items.q: fixed cost may be defined as
o: an expense that is incurred whether the machine works or not
the formation and collapse of vapour bubbles in a pump that damages its parts
the shift of load from the front axle to the rear axle caused by the pull of an implement
a scale showing how readily a diesel fuel ignites when it is injected into hot air
items.s: fixed cost: an expense that is incurred whether the machine works or not. The other options describe cavitation, weight transfer, cetane rating.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines total head?
o: the unthreshed heads and partly cleaned grain returned for a second pass
a one way valve at the foot of a suction pipe that keeps the pump primed
the area a machine would cover in unit time at full width and full speed without any stop
the sum of the static lift and the friction and velocity losses in a pumping system
items.s: total head: the sum of the static lift and the friction and velocity losses in a pumping system. The other options describe theoretical field capacity, tailings, foot valve.

items.q: Which term is described by “the grain left on the ground or on the stubble by the cutting unit of a harvester”?
o: cleaning shoe
header loss
combine harvester
tailings
items.s: header loss is the grain left on the ground or on the stubble by the cutting unit of a harvester.

items.q: cavitation may be defined as
o: the ratio of the power in the water delivered to the power supplied to the pump
the formation and collapse of vapour bubbles in a pump that damages its parts
a scale showing how well a petrol resists knocking in a spark ignition engine
the shaft at the rear of a tractor that drives machines mounted on or trailed by it
items.s: cavitation: the formation and collapse of vapour bubbles in a pump that damages its parts. The other options describe pump efficiency, power take off, octane rating.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines octane rating.
o: a scale showing how well a petrol resists knocking in a spark ignition engine
a lump of soil left unbroken after a tillage operation
the mass of crop a machine handles in unit time
the heat released when unit mass of a fuel is burned completely
items.s: octane rating: a scale showing how well a petrol resists knocking in a spark ignition engine. The other options describe throughput, clod, calorific value.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines specific fuel consumption.
o: the transmission of power between two pulleys by an endless flexible band
the mounting that carries an implement behind a tractor and controls the depth of work
an implement that cuts, lifts and turns a furrow slice over
the mass of fuel burned for each unit of work delivered at the shaft
items.s: specific fuel consumption: the mass of fuel burned for each unit of work delivered at the shaft. The other options describe three point linkage, belt drive, mouldboard plough.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines precision planting?
o: the grain left on the ground or on the stubble by the cutting unit of a harvester
the placing of single seeds at accurately spaced intervals along the row
the charge for the capital tied up in a machine
a heavy tined implement that loosens soil below the depth reached by ordinary ploughing
items.s: precision planting: the placing of single seeds at accurately spaced intervals along the row. The other options describe subsoiler, header loss, interest on investment.

items.q: timeliness may be defined as
o: the ability to carry out a farm operation within the period when it gives the best return
the time lost at the end of a run in turning and lining up for the next run
the space left above the piston when it stands at the top of its travel
a lump of soil left unbroken after a tillage operation
items.s: timeliness: the ability to carry out a farm operation within the period when it gives the best return. The other options describe clearance volume, turn around time, clod.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines clod.
o: the mass of air supplied for each unit mass of fuel burned
the volume displaced by the piston as it travels from the top to the bottom of its stroke
the mounting that carries an implement behind a tractor and controls the depth of work
a lump of soil left unbroken after a tillage operation
items.s: clod: a lump of soil left unbroken after a tillage operation. The other options describe swept volume, three point linkage, air fuel ratio.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines implement width?
o: the fall in the value of a machine through age, wear and obsolescence
the small gap left between the valve stem and the rocker so that the valve can close fully when hot
the working breadth of a machine measured at right angles to its direction of travel
the useful power measured at the output shaft of an engine
items.s: implement width: the working breadth of a machine measured at right angles to its direction of travel. The other options describe depreciation, brake power, valve clearance.

items.q: The statement “an expense that is incurred whether the machine works or not” describes which of the following?
o: interest on investment
fixed cost
useful life
salvage value
items.s: fixed cost is an expense that is incurred whether the machine works or not.

items.q: mechanical efficiency may be defined as
o: the letting out of a machine and its operator to another farmer for a fee
the total cost of an operation divided by the area it covered
the time lost at the end of a run in turning and lining up for the next run
the ratio of the power delivered at the shaft to the power developed inside the cylinders
items.s: mechanical efficiency: the ratio of the power delivered at the shaft to the power developed inside the cylinders. The other options describe custom hire, cost per hectare, turn around time.

items.q: The statement “the distance between the centres of two adjacent crop rows” describes which of the following?
o: planter
seed drill
row spacing
precision planting
items.s: row spacing is the distance between the centres of two adjacent crop rows.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines cost per hectare?
o: a device that mixes petrol with air before the mixture is drawn into the engine
the proportion of the grain in the crop that is separated from the straw
a machine that cuts, threshes and cleans a grain crop in one operation
the total cost of an operation divided by the area it covered
items.s: cost per hectare: the total cost of an operation divided by the area it covered. The other options describe threshing efficiency, combine harvester, carburettor.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines germination percentage?
o: the ratio of the power at the drawbar to the power delivered to the driving wheels
the number of turns of the driving gear needed to produce one turn of the driven gear
the proportion of seeds that produce normal seedlings under test conditions
the space left above the piston when it stands at the top of its travel
items.s: germination percentage: the proportion of seeds that produce normal seedlings under test conditions. The other options describe gear ratio, clearance volume, tractive efficiency.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines thousand grain weight?
o: a mechanism that holds engine speed steady by varying the fuel supplied as the load changes
a machine that opens a furrow, places seed at a set rate and covers it
the mass of one thousand seeds of a crop, used to turn seed numbers into mass
the transmission of power between two sprockets by a linked metal chain
items.s: thousand grain weight: the mass of one thousand seeds of a crop, used to turn seed numbers into mass. The other options describe seed drill, chain drive, governor.

items.q: detonation may be defined as
o: a coupling that connects or disconnects the engine from the transmission
the highest position reached by the piston inside the cylinder
the explosive burning of the last part of the charge after the flame front has passed
the share of the heat energy in the fuel that is turned into useful work at the shaft
items.s: detonation: the explosive burning of the last part of the charge after the flame front has passed. The other options describe clutch, top dead centre, thermal efficiency.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines theoretical field capacity?
o: the shift of load from the front axle to the rear axle caused by the pull of an implement
the power measured at the hitch where an implement is pulled
the area a machine would cover in unit time at full width and full speed without any stop
the gear arrangement that lets the two driving wheels turn at different speeds on a curve
items.s: theoretical field capacity: the area a machine would cover in unit time at full width and full speed without any stop. The other options describe weight transfer, differential, drawbar power.

items.q: Which of the following best describes metering mechanism?
o: the fall in the value of a machine through age, wear and obsolescence
the gap between the threshing drum and the curved grate beneath it
the time lost at the end of a run in turning and lining up for the next run
the part of a seeder that measures out seed at a steady rate
items.s: metering mechanism: the part of a seeder that measures out seed at a steady rate. The other options describe concave clearance, depreciation, turn around time.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines interest on investment?
o: an expense that is incurred whether the machine works or not
the ratio of the total cylinder volume to the volume left above the piston at top dead centre
the sequence of intake, compression, power and exhaust strokes completed in two turns of the crankshaft
the charge for the capital tied up in a machine
items.s: interest on investment: the charge for the capital tied up in a machine. The other options describe compression ratio, four stroke cycle, fixed cost.

items.q: The statement “a mechanism that holds engine speed steady by varying the fuel supplied as the load changes” describes which of the following?
o: four stroke cycle
two stroke cycle
governor
carburettor
items.s: governor is a mechanism that holds engine speed steady by varying the fuel supplied as the load changes.

items.q: The statement “the shaft at the rear of a tractor that drives machines mounted on or trailed by it” describes which of the following?
o: power take off
belt drive
torque
differential
items.s: power take off is the shaft at the rear of a tractor that drives machines mounted on or trailed by it.

items.q: The statement “the proportion of the grain in the crop that is separated from the straw” describes which of the following?
o: concave clearance
threshing
header loss
threshing efficiency
items.s: threshing efficiency is the proportion of the grain in the crop that is separated from the straw.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines metering mechanism?
o: the ability to carry out a farm operation within the period when it gives the best return
the part of a seeder that measures out seed at a steady rate
the proportion of the grain in the crop that is separated from the straw
the mass or number of seeds sown on a unit area of land
items.s: metering mechanism: the part of a seeder that measures out seed at a steady rate. The other options describe seed rate, timeliness, threshing efficiency.

items.q: Which of the following best describes cetane rating?
o: the mass or number of seeds sown on a unit area of land
the area or mass of material handled by a machine in unit time
the letting out of a machine and its operator to another farmer for a fee
a scale showing how readily a diesel fuel ignites when it is injected into hot air
items.s: cetane rating: a scale showing how readily a diesel fuel ignites when it is injected into hot air. The other options describe work rate, seed rate, custom hire.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines priming?
o: the area actually covered in unit time after allowing for turns, refilling and other delays
the filling of a pump and its suction line with water before it is started
the area or mass of material handled by a machine in unit time
the mass of one thousand seeds of a crop, used to turn seed numbers into mass
items.s: priming: the filling of a pump and its suction line with water before it is started. The other options describe work rate, effective field capacity, thousand grain weight.

items.q: Which of the following best describes fuel injector?
o: the useful power measured at the output shaft of an engine
a mechanism that holds engine speed steady by varying the fuel supplied as the load changes
a nozzle that sprays metered fuel into the combustion chamber under high pressure
the number of years a machine is expected to serve before replacement
items.s: fuel injector: a nozzle that sprays metered fuel into the combustion chamber under high pressure. The other options describe useful life, brake power, governor.

items.q: Which term is described by “a heavy tined implement that loosens soil below the depth reached by ordinary ploughing”?
o: subsoiler
harrow
rotavator
disc plough
items.s: subsoiler is a heavy tined implement that loosens soil below the depth reached by ordinary ploughing.

items.q: priming may be defined as
o: the ratio of the horizontal pull developed to the vertical load carried by the driving wheels
the unthreshed heads and partly cleaned grain returned for a second pass
the shaft at the rear of a tractor that drives machines mounted on or trailed by it
the filling of a pump and its suction line with water before it is started
items.s: priming: the filling of a pump and its suction line with water before it is started. The other options describe power take off, coefficient of traction, tailings.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines theoretical field capacity.
o: the area a machine would cover in unit time at full width and full speed without any stop
the turning effect of a force about the axis of a shaft
the total cost of an operation divided by the area it covered
a machine whose powered blades chop and mix the soil in a single pass
items.s: theoretical field capacity: the area a machine would cover in unit time at full width and full speed without any stop. The other options describe cost per hectare, torque, rotavator.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines work rate?
o: the area or mass of material handled by a machine in unit time
the operation in a sequence that limits the output of the whole system
a machine that opens a furrow, places seed at a set rate and covers it
the proportion of seeds that produce normal seedlings under test conditions
items.s: work rate: the area or mass of material handled by a machine in unit time. The other options describe seed drill, bottleneck, germination percentage.

items.q: Which term is described by “a one way valve at the foot of a suction pipe that keeps the pump primed”?
o: suction lift
water hammer
foot valve
total head
items.s: foot valve is a one way valve at the foot of a suction pipe that keeps the pump primed.

items.q: carburettor may be defined as
o: an expense that rises with the amount of work the machine does
a device that mixes petrol with air before the mixture is drawn into the engine
the letting out of a machine and its operator to another farmer for a fee
the turning effect of a force about the axis of a shaft
items.s: carburettor: a device that mixes petrol with air before the mixture is drawn into the engine. The other options describe variable cost, torque, custom hire.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines discharge.
o: the power measured at the hitch where an implement is pulled
the volume of water delivered by a pump in unit time
the force that opposes the motion of a wheel over ground because the soil is pressed down
a machine that opens a furrow, places seed at a set rate and covers it
items.s: discharge: the volume of water delivered by a pump in unit time. The other options describe seed drill, drawbar power, rolling resistance.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines air fuel ratio?
o: the pull required for each unit width of an implement
the mass of air supplied for each unit mass of fuel burned
the price a machine is expected to fetch when it is finally sold
the mass of one thousand seeds of a crop, used to turn seed numbers into mass
items.s: air fuel ratio: the mass of air supplied for each unit mass of fuel burned. The other options describe thousand grain weight, salvage value, unit draft.

items.q: Which of the following best describes header loss?
o: the useful power measured at the output shaft of an engine
a nozzle that sprays metered fuel into the combustion chamber under high pressure
the grain left on the ground or on the stubble by the cutting unit of a harvester
a control that makes both driving wheels turn together when one of them loses grip
items.s: header loss: the grain left on the ground or on the stubble by the cutting unit of a harvester. The other options describe differential lock, brake power, fuel injector.

items.q: Which of the following best describes rolling resistance?
o: a nozzle that sprays metered fuel into the combustion chamber under high pressure
the pressure surge caused by a sudden stop in the flow of water in a pipe
the ratio of the power in the water delivered to the power supplied to the pump
the force that opposes the motion of a wheel over ground because the soil is pressed down
items.s: rolling resistance: the force that opposes the motion of a wheel over ground because the soil is pressed down. The other options describe fuel injector, pump efficiency, water hammer.

items.q: The statement “the area a machine would cover in unit time at full width and full speed without any stop” describes which of the following?
o: work rate
theoretical field capacity
implement width
timeliness
items.s: theoretical field capacity is the area a machine would cover in unit time at full width and full speed without any stop.

items.q: The statement “a nozzle that sprays metered fuel into the combustion chamber under high pressure” describes which of the following?
o: fuel injector
top dead centre
carburettor
valve clearance
items.s: fuel injector is a nozzle that sprays metered fuel into the combustion chamber under high pressure.

items.q: Which of the following best describes torque?
o: the turning effect of a force about the axis of a shaft
the vertical distance from the water surface to the centre of the pump
the filling of a pump and its suction line with water before it is started
the addition of weight to a tractor so that its driving wheels grip better
items.s: torque: the turning effect of a force about the axis of a shaft. The other options describe ballasting, suction lift, priming.

items.q: differential may be defined as
o: the pull required for each unit width of an implement
the shaft at the rear of a tractor that drives machines mounted on or trailed by it
the mass or number of seeds sown on a unit area of land
the gear arrangement that lets the two driving wheels turn at different speeds on a curve
items.s: differential: the gear arrangement that lets the two driving wheels turn at different speeds on a curve. The other options describe unit draft, power take off, seed rate.

items.q: interest on investment may be defined as
o: a cycle in which every turn of the crankshaft produces one power stroke
the ratio of the volume of air actually drawn in to the swept volume of the cylinders
the charge for the capital tied up in a machine
the sequence of intake, compression, power and exhaust strokes completed in two turns of the crankshaft
items.s: interest on investment: the charge for the capital tied up in a machine. The other options describe four stroke cycle, volumetric efficiency, two stroke cycle.

items.q: Which term is described by “the heat released when unit mass of a fuel is burned completely”?
o: air fuel ratio
detonation
specific fuel consumption
calorific value
items.s: calorific value is the heat released when unit mass of a fuel is burned completely.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines salvage value?
o: the placing of single seeds at accurately spaced intervals along the row
the useful power measured at the output shaft of an engine
the number of turns of the driving gear needed to produce one turn of the driven gear
the price a machine is expected to fetch when it is finally sold
items.s: salvage value: the price a machine is expected to fetch when it is finally sold. The other options describe gear ratio, brake power, precision planting.

items.q: Which term is described by “a mechanism that holds engine speed steady by varying the fuel supplied as the load changes”?
o: swept volume
two stroke cycle
valve clearance
governor
items.s: governor is a mechanism that holds engine speed steady by varying the fuel supplied as the load changes.

items.q: tractive efficiency may be defined as
o: the ratio of the power at the drawbar to the power delivered to the driving wheels
the mass of one thousand seeds of a crop, used to turn seed numbers into mass
a machine whose powered blades chop and mix the soil in a single pass
the ratio of the horizontal pull developed to the vertical load carried by the driving wheels
items.s: tractive efficiency: the ratio of the power at the drawbar to the power delivered to the driving wheels. The other options describe coefficient of traction, thousand grain weight, rotavator.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines mouldboard plough?
o: the pull required for each unit width of an implement
a nozzle that sprays metered fuel into the combustion chamber under high pressure
the filling of a pump and its suction line with water before it is started
an implement that cuts, lifts and turns a furrow slice over
items.s: mouldboard plough: an implement that cuts, lifts and turns a furrow slice over. The other options describe priming, unit draft, fuel injector.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines cylinder speed?
o: a nozzle that sprays metered fuel into the combustion chamber under high pressure
the rate at which the rotating drum of a thresher turns
the area actually covered in unit time after allowing for turns, refilling and other delays
a mechanism that holds engine speed steady by varying the fuel supplied as the load changes
items.s: cylinder speed: the rate at which the rotating drum of a thresher turns. The other options describe governor, effective field capacity, fuel injector.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines detonation?
o: the transmission of power between two pulleys by an endless flexible band
an expense that rises with the amount of work the machine does
the rate at which the rotating drum of a thresher turns
the explosive burning of the last part of the charge after the flame front has passed
items.s: detonation: the explosive burning of the last part of the charge after the flame front has passed. The other options describe belt drive, variable cost, cylinder speed.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines compression ratio?
o: an implement whose revolving concave discs cut and invert the soil
the ratio of the total cylinder volume to the volume left above the piston at top dead centre
a scale showing how readily a diesel fuel ignites when it is injected into hot air
the proportion of seeds that produce normal seedlings under test conditions
items.s: compression ratio: the ratio of the total cylinder volume to the volume left above the piston at top dead centre. The other options describe disc plough, cetane rating, germination percentage.

items.q: Which of the following best describes suction lift?
o: the gear arrangement that lets the two driving wheels turn at different speeds on a curve
an expense that is incurred whether the machine works or not
a device that mixes petrol with air before the mixture is drawn into the engine
the vertical distance from the water surface to the centre of the pump
items.s: suction lift: the vertical distance from the water surface to the centre of the pump. The other options describe fixed cost, carburettor, differential.

items.q: Which of the following best describes theoretical field capacity?
o: the area a machine would cover in unit time at full width and full speed without any stop
a scale showing how well a petrol resists knocking in a spark ignition engine
the explosive burning of the last part of the charge after the flame front has passed
a machine that places individual seeds or vegetative material at a set spacing
items.s: theoretical field capacity: the area a machine would cover in unit time at full width and full speed without any stop. The other options describe planter, detonation, octane rating.

items.q: weight transfer may be defined as
o: the grain left on the ground or on the stubble by the cutting unit of a harvester
the last reduction gear set that carries drive from the transmission to the wheels
the shift of load from the front axle to the rear axle caused by the pull of an implement
the price a machine is expected to fetch when it is finally sold
items.s: weight transfer: the shift of load from the front axle to the rear axle caused by the pull of an implement. The other options describe final drive, header loss, salvage value.

items.q: All of the following belong to Tillage tools and draft EXCEPT
o: unit draft
specific draft
germination percentage
draft
items.s: Every other option belongs to Tillage tools and draft. “germination percentage” belongs to Planting and seeding machinery, not Tillage tools and draft.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines custom hire.
o: the grain left on the ground or on the stubble by the cutting unit of a harvester
the letting out of a machine and its operator to another farmer for a fee
the rate at which the rotating drum of a thresher turns
the ability to carry out a farm operation within the period when it gives the best return
items.s: custom hire: the letting out of a machine and its operator to another farmer for a fee. The other options describe cylinder speed, timeliness, header loss.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines discharge?
o: the volume of water delivered by a pump in unit time
a mechanism that holds engine speed steady by varying the fuel supplied as the load changes
the turning effect of a force about the axis of a shaft
a heavy tined implement that loosens soil below the depth reached by ordinary ploughing
items.s: discharge: the volume of water delivered by a pump in unit time. The other options describe subsoiler, governor, torque.

items.q: throughput may be defined as
o: a one way valve at the foot of a suction pipe that keeps the pump primed
the pull required for each unit of cross sectional area of soil cut
the mass of crop a machine handles in unit time
the volume of water delivered by a pump in unit time
items.s: throughput: the mass of crop a machine handles in unit time. The other options describe foot valve, discharge, specific draft.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines threshing?
o: the gear arrangement that lets the two driving wheels turn at different speeds on a curve
the separation of grain from the ear or pod by impact, rubbing or beating
an implement that cuts, lifts and turns a furrow slice over
the sum of the static lift and the friction and velocity losses in a pumping system
items.s: threshing: the separation of grain from the ear or pod by impact, rubbing or beating. The other options describe total head, differential, mouldboard plough.

items.q: suction lift may be defined as
o: an expense that is incurred whether the machine works or not
a device that mixes petrol with air before the mixture is drawn into the engine
the vertical distance from the water surface to the centre of the pump
the operation in a sequence that limits the output of the whole system
items.s: suction lift: the vertical distance from the water surface to the centre of the pump. The other options describe fixed cost, bottleneck, carburettor.

items.q: Which of the following best describes rotavator?
o: the proportion of the grain in the crop that is separated from the straw
a one way valve at the foot of a suction pipe that keeps the pump primed
an expense that rises with the amount of work the machine does
a machine whose powered blades chop and mix the soil in a single pass
items.s: rotavator: a machine whose powered blades chop and mix the soil in a single pass. The other options describe threshing efficiency, variable cost, foot valve.

items.q: Which of the following best describes mouldboard plough?
o: the mass of crop a machine handles in unit time
the vertical distance from the water surface to the centre of the pump
the operation in a sequence that limits the output of the whole system
an implement that cuts, lifts and turns a furrow slice over
items.s: mouldboard plough: an implement that cuts, lifts and turns a furrow slice over. The other options describe throughput, bottleneck, suction lift.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines differential.
o: the price a machine is expected to fetch when it is finally sold
the sieves and blower that remove chaff and broken material from threshed grain
the fall in the value of a machine through age, wear and obsolescence
the gear arrangement that lets the two driving wheels turn at different speeds on a curve
items.s: differential: the gear arrangement that lets the two driving wheels turn at different speeds on a curve. The other options describe depreciation, cleaning shoe, salvage value.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines tractive efficiency.
o: an implement with many tines or discs used to break clods and level a seedbed
the ratio of the power at the drawbar to the power delivered to the driving wheels
the number of years a machine is expected to serve before replacement
a control that makes both driving wheels turn together when one of them loses grip
items.s: tractive efficiency: the ratio of the power at the drawbar to the power delivered to the driving wheels. The other options describe differential lock, harrow, useful life.

items.q: A 6 cylinder four stroke engine has a bore of 100 mm and a stroke of 115 mm. Calculate its total piston displacement in litres.
items.s: One cylinder displaces 903.2 cm3, so 6 cylinders displace 6 x 903.2 = 5419 cm3 = 5.42 litres.

items.q: An engine develops a brake power of 52 kW at 2200 revolutions per minute. Calculate the torque it delivers in N m.
items.s: Torque = power x 60000/(2 x pi x speed) = 52 x 60000/(2 x pi x 2200) = 225.7 N m.

items.q: A tractor engine consumes 12 kg of diesel per hour while delivering 75 kW at the shaft. Calculate the specific fuel consumption in kg/kWh.
items.s: Specific fuel consumption = fuel used per hour/power = 12/75 = 0.16 kg/kWh.

items.q: An engine burns 6.5 kg of fuel per hour and the calorific value of the fuel is 44.5 MJ/kg. Calculate the heat energy released per hour expressed as a power in kW.
items.s: Fuel power = mass per hour x calorific value/3.6 = 6.5 x 44.5/3.6 = 80.3 kW.

items.q: A tractor pulls an implement with a draft of 4.5 kN at a forward speed of 8 km/h. Calculate the drawbar power in kW.
items.s: Drawbar power = draft x speed/3.6 = 4.5 x 8/3.6 = 10 kW.

items.q: The torque at the axle of a tractor wheel is 2400 N m and the rolling radius of the wheel is 0.75 m. Calculate the tractive force at the rim in N.
items.s: Tractive force = torque/radius = 2400/0.75 = 3200 N.

items.q: A gearbox receives 200 N m of torque from the engine and has a reduction ratio of 4.5. Calculate the torque at the output shaft in N m, taking the drive as ideal.
items.s: Output torque = input torque x gear ratio = 200 x 4.5 = 900 N m.

items.q: A belt runs on a pulley of 0.3 m diameter turning at 1000 revolutions per minute. Calculate the linear speed of the belt in m/s.
items.s: Belt speed = pi x diameter x speed/60 = pi x 0.3 x 1000/60 = 15.71 m/s.

items.q: A plough requires a draft of 20 kN and is worked at 5 km/h. Calculate the power required to pull it in kW.
items.s: Draft power = draft x speed/3.6 = 20 x 5/3.6 = 27.78 kW.

items.q: A machine of width 3 m works at 8 km/h and its field efficiency is 85 percent. Calculate the effective field capacity in hectares per hour.
items.s: Theoretical capacity = 3 x 8/10 = 2.4 ha/h, so effective capacity = 2.4 x 85/100 = 2.04 ha/h.

items.q: A machine has an effective field capacity of 1.8 ha/h and works 6 hours in a day. Calculate the area it can cover in a day in hectares.
items.s: Area per day = capacity x hours = 1.8 x 6 = 10.8 hectares.

items.q: A thresher delivers 2400 kg of separated grain from a crop that contains 2600 kg of grain in all. Calculate the threshing efficiency in percent.
items.s: Threshing efficiency = separated grain/total grain x 100 = 2400/2600 x 100 = 92.3 percent.

items.q: The threshing cylinder of a machine has a diameter of 450 mm and turns at 700 revolutions per minute. Calculate the peripheral speed of the cylinder in m/s.
items.s: Peripheral speed = pi x diameter x speed/60 = pi x 0.45 x 700/60 = 16.49 m/s.

items.q: A pump of 4.5 kW runs for 6 hours and electrical energy costs 30 naira per kWh. Calculate the cost of the energy used in naira.
items.s: Energy used = 4.5 x 6 = 27 kWh, so cost = 27 x 30 = 810 naira.

items.q: A tractor engine cylinder has a bore of 90 mm and a piston stroke of 100 mm. Calculate the swept volume of one cylinder in cm3.
items.s: Swept volume = (pi/4) x bore^2 x stroke = (pi/4) x 9^2 x 10 = 636.2 cm3.

items.q: The swept volume of an engine cylinder is 750 cm3 and its clearance volume is 50 cm3. Calculate the compression ratio.
items.s: Compression ratio = (swept + clearance)/clearance = (750 + 50)/50 = 16.

items.q: A tractor engine runs at 1500 revolutions per minute and has a stroke of 110 mm. Calculate the mean piston speed in m/s.
items.s: Mean piston speed = 2 x stroke x speed/60 = 2 x 0.11 x 1500/60 = 5.5 m/s.

items.q: A four stroke engine of 3.5 litre displacement develops 30 kW at 2400 revolutions per minute. Calculate the brake mean effective pressure in kPa.
items.s: bmep = 120000 x power/(displacement x speed) = 120000 x 30/(3.5 x 2400) = 428.6 kPa.

items.q: An engine uses 4.5 kg of fuel per hour, the fuel having a calorific value of 43 MJ/kg, and delivers 52 kW at the shaft. Calculate its brake thermal efficiency in percent.
items.s: Fuel power = 4.5 x 43/3.6 = 53.8 kW. Thermal efficiency = 52/53.8 x 100 = 96.7 percent.

items.q: An engine takes in 540 kg of air per hour and burns 65 kg of fuel in the same period. Calculate the air fuel ratio.
items.s: Air fuel ratio = mass of air/mass of fuel = 540/65 = 8.3.

items.q: A tractor wheel would cover 250 m in a given time if it rolled without slipping but it actually covers 238 m. Calculate the wheel slip in percent.
items.s: Slip = (theoretical distance - actual distance)/theoretical distance x 100 = (250 - 238)/250 x 100 = 4.8 percent.

items.q: At a given setting a tractor delivers 22 kW at the drawbar while 30 kW reaches the driving wheels. Calculate the tractive efficiency in percent.
items.s: Tractive efficiency = drawbar power/wheel power x 100 = 22/30 x 100 = 73.3 percent.

items.q: A trailer of weight 36 kN runs on a soil whose coefficient of rolling resistance is 0.06. Calculate the rolling resistance in kN.
items.s: Rolling resistance = coefficient x weight = 0.06 x 36 = 2.16 kN.

items.q: A drawbar pull of 12 kN must be developed on a soil where the coefficient of traction is 0.5. Calculate the vertical load needed on the driving wheels in kN.
items.s: Vertical load = pull/coefficient of traction = 12/0.5 = 24 kN.

items.q: A pulley of 20 cm diameter running at 900 revolutions per minute drives a pulley of 80 cm diameter by a belt. Calculate the speed of the driven pulley.
items.s: N2 = N1 x D1/D2 = 900 x 20/80 = 225 revolutions per minute.

items.q: The unit draft of a tillage implement is 16 kN per metre of width and the implement is 2 m wide. Calculate the total draft in kN.
items.s: Total draft = unit draft x width = 16 x 2 = 32 kN.

items.q: An implement of width 2 m working at a depth of 0.2 m requires a draft of 12000 N. Calculate the specific draft in kPa.
items.s: Area of soil cut = 2 x 0.2 = 0.4 m2, so specific draft = 12000/0.4 = 30000 Pa = 30 kPa.

items.q: An implement 2.5 m wide is worked at a speed of 5 km/h. Calculate the theoretical field capacity in hectares per hour.
items.s: Theoretical field capacity = width x speed/10 = 2.5 x 5/10 = 1.25 ha/h.

items.q: The theoretical field capacity of a machine is 4 ha/h while its effective field capacity is 1.8 ha/h. Calculate the field efficiency in percent.
items.s: Field efficiency = effective/theoretical x 100 = 1.8/4 x 100 = 45 percent.

items.q: A field of 24 hectares is to be worked by a machine whose effective field capacity is 1.8 ha/h. Calculate the time needed in hours.
items.s: Time = area/capacity = 24/1.8 = 13.33 hours.

items.q: A tractor uses 21 litres of diesel per hour and works at an effective field capacity of 1.2 ha/h. Calculate the fuel consumption per hectare in litres.
items.s: Fuel per hectare = use per hour/capacity = 21/1.2 = 17.5 litres per hectare.

items.q: A crop is planted at a within row spacing of 25 cm with a row spacing of 90 cm. Calculate the plant population in plants per hectare.
items.s: Population = 100000000/(spacing x row spacing) = 100000000/(25 x 90) = 44444 plants per hectare.

items.q: A seed rate gives a population of 250000 plants per hectare and the thousand grain weight of the seed is 40 g. Calculate the mass of seed required per hectare in kg.
items.s: Seed mass = population x thousand grain weight/1000000 = 250000 x 40/1000000 = 10 kg per hectare.

items.q: A planter drops 30 seeds over a travelled distance of 3 m. Calculate the average number of seeds per metre of row.
items.s: Seeds per metre = number of seeds/distance = 30/3 = 10.

items.q: A combine harvester leaves 80 kg of grain per hectare on the ground while the total yield of the field is 3500 kg per hectare. Calculate the header loss in percent.
items.s: Header loss = grain lost/yield x 100 = 80/3500 x 100 = 2.29 percent.

items.q: A threshing machine handles 30 tonnes of crop in 8 hours. Calculate its throughput in tonnes per hour.
items.s: Throughput = mass/time = 30/8 = 3.75 tonnes per hour.

items.q: The cleaning unit of a thresher passes 810 kg of clean grain out of a total output of 1100 kg of material. Calculate the cleaning efficiency in percent.
items.s: Cleaning efficiency = clean grain/total output x 100 = 810/1100 x 100 = 73.6 percent.

items.q: A tractor costs 3000000 naira and is expected to have a salvage value of 600000 naira after 15 years. Calculate its annual depreciation by the straight line method in naira.
items.s: Depreciation = (cost - salvage value)/life = (3000000 - 600000)/15 = 160000 naira per year.

items.q: A machine costs 2500000 naira, will be worth 800000 naira at the end of its life, and the rate of interest on capital is 12 percent. Calculate the average annual interest charge in naira.
items.s: Average investment = (2500000 + 800000)/2 = 1650000, so interest = 1650000 x 12/100 = 198000 naira per year.

items.q: The annual fixed cost of a machine is 300000 naira, it is used for 800 hours in the year and its variable cost is 900 naira per hour. Calculate the total cost per hour in naira.
items.s: Fixed cost per hour = 300000/800 = 375 naira, so total cost per hour = 375 + 900 = 1275 naira.

items.q: An operation costs 1200 naira per hour and the machine works at an effective field capacity of 1 ha/h. Calculate the cost of the operation per hectare in naira.
items.s: Cost per hectare = cost per hour/capacity = 1200/1 = 1200 naira.

items.q: A pump delivers 12 litres per second against a total head of 25 m with an efficiency of 75 percent. Calculate the power required to drive it in kW.
items.s: Power = 9.81 x discharge x head/(1000 x efficiency) = 9.81 x 12 x 25/(1000 x 0.75) = 3.92 kW.

items.q: An engine has a compression ratio of 18 and a swept volume of 500 cm3. Calculate its clearance volume in cm3.
items.s: Clearance volume = swept volume/(compression ratio - 1) = 500/17 = 29.4 cm3.

items.q: A 4 cylinder four stroke engine has a bore of 85 mm and a stroke of 120 mm. Calculate its total piston displacement in litres.
items.s: One cylinder displaces 680.9 cm3, so 4 cylinders displace 4 x 680.9 = 2724 cm3 = 2.72 litres.

items.q: An engine develops a brake power of 90 kW at 1800 revolutions per minute. Calculate the torque it delivers in N m.
items.s: Torque = power x 60000/(2 x pi x speed) = 90 x 60000/(2 x pi x 1800) = 477.5 N m.

items.q: A tractor engine consumes 9 kg of diesel per hour while delivering 50 kW at the shaft. Calculate the specific fuel consumption in kg/kWh.
items.s: Specific fuel consumption = fuel used per hour/power = 9/50 = 0.18 kg/kWh.

items.q: An engine burns 11 kg of fuel per hour and the calorific value of the fuel is 44.5 MJ/kg. Calculate the heat energy released per hour expressed as a power in kW.
items.s: Fuel power = mass per hour x calorific value/3.6 = 11 x 44.5/3.6 = 136 kW.

items.q: A tractor pulls an implement with a draft of 5.5 kN at a forward speed of 4 km/h. Calculate the drawbar power in kW.
items.s: Drawbar power = draft x speed/3.6 = 5.5 x 4/3.6 = 6.11 kW.

items.q: The torque at the axle of a tractor wheel is 5400 N m and the rolling radius of the wheel is 0.7 m. Calculate the tractive force at the rim in N.
items.s: Tractive force = torque/radius = 5400/0.7 = 7714 N.

items.q: A gearbox receives 200 N m of torque from the engine and has a reduction ratio of 5. Calculate the torque at the output shaft in N m, taking the drive as ideal.
items.s: Output torque = input torque x gear ratio = 200 x 5 = 1000 N m.

items.q: A belt runs on a pulley of 0.25 m diameter turning at 1000 revolutions per minute. Calculate the linear speed of the belt in m/s.
items.s: Belt speed = pi x diameter x speed/60 = pi x 0.25 x 1000/60 = 13.09 m/s.

items.q: A machine of width 3 m works at 5 km/h and its field efficiency is 85 percent. Calculate the effective field capacity in hectares per hour.
items.s: Theoretical capacity = 3 x 5/10 = 1.5 ha/h, so effective capacity = 1.5 x 85/100 = 1.27 ha/h.

items.q: A machine has an effective field capacity of 1.2 ha/h and works 9 hours in a day. Calculate the area it can cover in a day in hectares.
items.s: Area per day = capacity x hours = 1.2 x 9 = 10.8 hectares.

items.q: The threshing cylinder of a machine has a diameter of 650 mm and turns at 1000 revolutions per minute. Calculate the peripheral speed of the cylinder in m/s.
items.s: Peripheral speed = pi x diameter x speed/60 = pi x 0.65 x 1000/60 = 34.03 m/s.

items.q: A pump of 5.5 kW runs for 5 hours and electrical energy costs 30 naira per kWh. Calculate the cost of the energy used in naira.
items.s: Energy used = 5.5 x 5 = 27.5 kWh, so cost = 27.5 x 30 = 825 naira.

items.q: A tractor engine cylinder has a bore of 90 mm and a piston stroke of 110 mm. Calculate the swept volume of one cylinder in cm3.
items.s: Swept volume = (pi/4) x bore^2 x stroke = (pi/4) x 9^2 x 11 = 699.8 cm3.

items.q: The swept volume of an engine cylinder is 450 cm3 and its clearance volume is 60 cm3. Calculate the compression ratio.
items.s: Compression ratio = (swept + clearance)/clearance = (450 + 60)/60 = 8.5.

items.q: A tractor engine runs at 1200 revolutions per minute and has a stroke of 140 mm. Calculate the mean piston speed in m/s.
items.s: Mean piston speed = 2 x stroke x speed/60 = 2 x 0.14 x 1200/60 = 5.6 m/s.

items.q: A four stroke engine of 4.5 litre displacement develops 52 kW at 1800 revolutions per minute. Calculate the brake mean effective pressure in kPa.
items.s: bmep = 120000 x power/(displacement x speed) = 120000 x 52/(4.5 x 1800) = 770.4 kPa.

items.q: An engine uses 10 kg of fuel per hour, the fuel having a calorific value of 43 MJ/kg, and delivers 52 kW at the shaft. Calculate its brake thermal efficiency in percent.
items.s: Fuel power = 10 x 43/3.6 = 119.4 kW. Thermal efficiency = 52/119.4 x 100 = 43.5 percent.

items.q: The statement “the ratio of the horizontal pull developed to the vertical load carried by the driving wheels” describes which of the following?
o: tractive efficiency
three point linkage
rolling resistance
coefficient of traction
items.s: coefficient of traction is the ratio of the horizontal pull developed to the vertical load carried by the driving wheels.

items.q: The best definition of disc plough among these is
o: the pull required for each unit of cross sectional area of soil cut
a lump of soil left unbroken after a tillage operation
an implement whose revolving concave discs cut and invert the soil
the horizontal force needed to pull an implement through the soil
items.s: disc plough: an implement whose revolving concave discs cut and invert the soil. The other options describe clod, specific draft, draft.

items.q: The best definition of harrow among these is
o: a machine whose powered blades chop and mix the soil in a single pass
the horizontal force needed to pull an implement through the soil
an implement that cuts, lifts and turns a furrow slice over
an implement with many tines or discs used to break clods and level a seedbed
items.s: harrow: an implement with many tines or discs used to break clods and level a seedbed. The other options describe draft, mouldboard plough, rotavator.

items.q: In this course, seed drill refers to
o: a machine that opens a furrow, places seed at a set rate and covers it
the part of a seeder that measures out seed at a steady rate
the mass or number of seeds sown on a unit area of land
the proportion of seeds that produce normal seedlings under test conditions
items.s: seed drill: a machine that opens a furrow, places seed at a set rate and covers it. The other options describe germination percentage, seed rate, metering mechanism.

items.q: priming is best described as
o: the formation and collapse of vapour bubbles in a pump that damages its parts
the sum of the static lift and the friction and velocity losses in a pumping system
the pressure surge caused by a sudden stop in the flow of water in a pipe
the filling of a pump and its suction line with water before it is started

items.q: At a given setting a tractor delivers 15 kW at the drawbar while 30 kW reaches the driving wheels. Calculate the tractive efficiency in percent.
items.s: Tractive efficiency = drawbar power/wheel power x 100 = 15/30 x 100 = 50 percent.

items.q: The theoretical field capacity of a machine is 2.4 ha/h while its effective field capacity is 1.9 ha/h. Calculate the field efficiency in percent.
items.s: Field efficiency = effective/theoretical x 100 = 1.9/2.4 x 100 = 79.2 percent.

items.q: A tractor uses 18 litres of diesel per hour and works at an effective field capacity of 1.5 ha/h. Calculate the fuel consumption per hectare in litres.
items.s: Fuel per hectare = use per hour/capacity = 18/1.5 = 12 litres per hectare.

items.q: A combine harvester leaves 80 kg of grain per hectare on the ground while the total yield of the field is 3000 kg per hectare. Calculate the header loss in percent.
items.s: Header loss = grain lost/yield x 100 = 80/3000 x 100 = 2.67 percent.

items.q: The cleaning unit of a thresher passes 880 kg of clean grain out of a total output of 1000 kg of material. Calculate the cleaning efficiency in percent.
items.s: Cleaning efficiency = clean grain/total output x 100 = 880/1000 x 100 = 88 percent.

items.q: The annual fixed cost of a machine is 300000 naira, it is used for 500 hours in the year and its variable cost is 1050 naira per hour. Calculate the total cost per hour in naira.
items.s: Fixed cost per hour = 300000/500 = 600 naira, so total cost per hour = 600 + 1050 = 1650 naira.

items.q: An operation costs 1200 naira per hour and the machine works at an effective field capacity of 0.8 ha/h. Calculate the cost of the operation per hectare in naira.
items.s: Cost per hectare = cost per hour/capacity = 1200/0.8 = 1500 naira.

items.q: A tractor engine cylinder has a bore of 110 mm and a piston stroke of 90 mm. Calculate the swept volume of one cylinder in cm3.
items.s: Swept volume = (pi/4) x bore^2 x stroke = (pi/4) x 11^2 x 9 = 855.3 cm3.

items.q: The swept volume of an engine cylinder is 600 cm3 and its clearance volume is 30 cm3. Calculate the compression ratio.
items.s: Compression ratio = (swept + clearance)/clearance = (600 + 30)/30 = 21.

items.q: An engine has a compression ratio of 16 and a swept volume of 680 cm3. Calculate its clearance volume in cm3.
items.s: Clearance volume = swept volume/(compression ratio - 1) = 680/15 = 45.3 cm3.

items.q: A 4 cylinder four stroke engine has a bore of 85 mm and a stroke of 100 mm. Calculate its total piston displacement in litres.
items.s: One cylinder displaces 567.5 cm3, so 4 cylinders displace 4 x 567.5 = 2270 cm3 = 2.27 litres.

items.q: A tractor engine runs at 1200 revolutions per minute and has a stroke of 120 mm. Calculate the mean piston speed in m/s.
items.s: Mean piston speed = 2 x stroke x speed/60 = 2 x 0.12 x 1200/60 = 4.8 m/s.

items.q: An engine develops a brake power of 35 kW at 2000 revolutions per minute. Calculate the torque it delivers in N m.
items.s: Torque = power x 60000/(2 x pi x speed) = 35 x 60000/(2 x pi x 2000) = 167.1 N m.

items.q: A four stroke engine of 3 litre displacement develops 36 kW at 2400 revolutions per minute. Calculate the brake mean effective pressure in kPa.
items.s: bmep = 120000 x power/(displacement x speed) = 120000 x 36/(3 x 2400) = 600 kPa.

items.q: An engine burns 6.5 kg of fuel per hour and the calorific value of the fuel is 42.5 MJ/kg. Calculate the heat energy released per hour expressed as a power in kW.
items.s: Fuel power = mass per hour x calorific value/3.6 = 6.5 x 42.5/3.6 = 76.7 kW.

items.q: An engine takes in 540 kg of air per hour and burns 50 kg of fuel in the same period. Calculate the air fuel ratio.
items.s: Air fuel ratio = mass of air/mass of fuel = 540/50 = 10.8.

items.q: A tractor pulls an implement with a draft of 5.5 kN at a forward speed of 8 km/h. Calculate the drawbar power in kW.
items.s: Drawbar power = draft x speed/3.6 = 5.5 x 8/3.6 = 12.22 kW.

items.q: A tractor wheel would cover 180 m in a given time if it rolled without slipping but it actually covers 144 m. Calculate the wheel slip in percent.
items.s: Slip = (theoretical distance - actual distance)/theoretical distance x 100 = (180 - 144)/180 x 100 = 20 percent.

items.q: A trailer of weight 36 kN runs on a soil whose coefficient of rolling resistance is 0.04. Calculate the rolling resistance in kN.
items.s: Rolling resistance = coefficient x weight = 0.04 x 36 = 1.44 kN.

items.q: The torque at the axle of a tractor wheel is 3600 N m and the rolling radius of the wheel is 0.7 m. Calculate the tractive force at the rim in N.
items.s: Tractive force = torque/radius = 3600/0.7 = 5143 N.

items.q: An engine turning at 2400 revolutions per minute drives through a gear ratio of 5. Calculate the speed of the output shaft in revolutions per minute.
items.s: Output speed = engine speed/gear ratio = 2400/5 = 480 revolutions per minute.

items.q: A gearbox receives 150 N m of torque from the engine and has a reduction ratio of 3. Calculate the torque at the output shaft in N m, taking the drive as ideal.
items.s: Output torque = input torque x gear ratio = 150 x 3 = 450 N m.

items.q: A pulley of 25 cm diameter running at 1440 revolutions per minute drives a pulley of 75 cm diameter by a belt. Calculate the speed of the driven pulley.
items.s: N2 = N1 x D1/D2 = 1440 x 25/75 = 480 revolutions per minute.

items.q: A belt runs on a pulley of 0.4 m diameter turning at 800 revolutions per minute. Calculate the linear speed of the belt in m/s.
items.s: Belt speed = pi x diameter x speed/60 = pi x 0.4 x 800/60 = 16.76 m/s.

items.q: The unit draft of a tillage implement is 16 kN per metre of width and the implement is 3.5 m wide. Calculate the total draft in kN.
items.s: Total draft = unit draft x width = 16 x 3.5 = 56 kN.

items.q: A plough requires a draft of 12 kN and is worked at 4.5 km/h. Calculate the power required to pull it in kW.
items.s: Draft power = draft x speed/3.6 = 12 x 4.5/3.6 = 15 kW.

items.q: An implement of width 1.5 m working at a depth of 0.25 m requires a draft of 12000 N. Calculate the specific draft in kPa.
items.s: Area of soil cut = 1.5 x 0.25 = 0.375 m2, so specific draft = 12000/0.375 = 32000 Pa = 32 kPa.

items.q: An implement 3.5 m wide is worked at a speed of 5 km/h. Calculate the theoretical field capacity in hectares per hour.
items.s: Theoretical field capacity = width x speed/10 = 3.5 x 5/10 = 1.75 ha/h.

items.q: A machine of width 2 m works at 5 km/h and its field efficiency is 85 percent. Calculate the effective field capacity in hectares per hour.
items.s: Theoretical capacity = 2 x 5/10 = 1 ha/h, so effective capacity = 1 x 85/100 = 0.85 ha/h.

items.q: A field of 12 hectares is to be worked by a machine whose effective field capacity is 1.2 ha/h. Calculate the time needed in hours.
items.s: Time = area/capacity = 12/1.2 = 10 hours.

items.q: A machine has an effective field capacity of 1.2 ha/h and works 7 hours in a day. Calculate the area it can cover in a day in hectares.
items.s: Area per day = capacity x hours = 1.2 x 7 = 8.4 hectares.

items.q: A planter drops 50 seeds over a travelled distance of 2.5 m. Calculate the average number of seeds per metre of row.
items.s: Seeds per metre = number of seeds/distance = 50/2.5 = 20.

items.q: A thresher delivers 1800 kg of separated grain from a crop that contains 2700 kg of grain in all. Calculate the threshing efficiency in percent.
items.s: Threshing efficiency = separated grain/total grain x 100 = 1800/2700 x 100 = 66.7 percent.

items.q: A threshing machine handles 18 tonnes of crop in 9 hours. Calculate its throughput in tonnes per hour.
items.s: Throughput = mass/time = 18/9 = 2 tonnes per hour.

items.q: The threshing cylinder of a machine has a diameter of 600 mm and turns at 700 revolutions per minute. Calculate the peripheral speed of the cylinder in m/s.
items.s: Peripheral speed = pi x diameter x speed/60 = pi x 0.6 x 700/60 = 21.99 m/s.

items.q: A tractor costs 1800000 naira and is expected to have a salvage value of 750000 naira after 15 years. Calculate its annual depreciation by the straight line method in naira.
items.s: Depreciation = (cost - salvage value)/life = (1800000 - 750000)/15 = 70000 naira per year.

items.q: A machine costs 3200000 naira, will be worth 600000 naira at the end of its life, and the rate of interest on capital is 14 percent. Calculate the average annual interest charge in naira.
items.s: Average investment = (3200000 + 600000)/2 = 1900000, so interest = 1900000 x 14/100 = 266000 naira per year.

items.q: A pump delivers 18 litres per second against a total head of 15 m with an efficiency of 75 percent. Calculate the power required to drive it in kW.
items.s: Power = 9.81 x discharge x head/(1000 x efficiency) = 9.81 x 18 x 15/(1000 x 0.75) = 3.53 kW.

items.q: A pump of 10 kW runs for 6 hours and electrical energy costs 30 naira per kWh. Calculate the cost of the energy used in naira.
items.s: Energy used = 10 x 6 = 60 kWh, so cost = 60 x 30 = 1800 naira.

items.q: An engine uses 8 kg of fuel per hour, the fuel having a calorific value of 44 MJ/kg, and delivers 40 kW at the shaft. Calculate its brake thermal efficiency in percent.
items.s: Fuel power = 8 x 44/3.6 = 97.8 kW. Thermal efficiency = 40/97.8 x 100 = 40.9 percent.

items.q: At a given setting a tractor delivers 15 kW at the drawbar while 18 kW reaches the driving wheels. Calculate the tractive efficiency in percent.
items.s: Tractive efficiency = drawbar power/wheel power x 100 = 15/18 x 100 = 83.3 percent.

items.q: A drawbar pull of 9 kN must be developed on a soil where the coefficient of traction is 0.5. Calculate the vertical load needed on the driving wheels in kN.
items.s: Vertical load = pull/coefficient of traction = 9/0.5 = 18 kN.

items.q: The theoretical field capacity of a machine is 3.6 ha/h while its effective field capacity is 2.7 ha/h. Calculate the field efficiency in percent.
items.s: Field efficiency = effective/theoretical x 100 = 2.7/3.6 x 100 = 75 percent.

items.q: A tractor uses 24 litres of diesel per hour and works at an effective field capacity of 0.8 ha/h. Calculate the fuel consumption per hectare in litres.
items.s: Fuel per hectare = use per hour/capacity = 24/0.8 = 30 litres per hectare.

items.q: A combine harvester leaves 100 kg of grain per hectare on the ground while the total yield of the field is 3000 kg per hectare. Calculate the header loss in percent.
items.s: Header loss = grain lost/yield x 100 = 100/3000 x 100 = 3.33 percent.

items.q: The cleaning unit of a thresher passes 950 kg of clean grain out of a total output of 1000 kg of material. Calculate the cleaning efficiency in percent.
items.s: Cleaning efficiency = clean grain/total output x 100 = 950/1000 x 100 = 95 percent.

items.q: The annual fixed cost of a machine is 240000 naira, it is used for 800 hours in the year and its variable cost is 600 naira per hour. Calculate the total cost per hour in naira.
items.s: Fixed cost per hour = 240000/800 = 300 naira, so total cost per hour = 300 + 600 = 900 naira.

items.q: An operation costs 1800 naira per hour and the machine works at an effective field capacity of 0.6 ha/h. Calculate the cost of the operation per hectare in naira.
items.s: Cost per hectare = cost per hour/capacity = 1800/0.6 = 3000 naira.

items.q: A tractor engine cylinder has a bore of 100 mm and a piston stroke of 120 mm. Calculate the swept volume of one cylinder in cm3.
items.s: Swept volume = (pi/4) x bore^2 x stroke = (pi/4) x 10^2 x 12 = 942.5 cm3.

items.q: The swept volume of an engine cylinder is 400 cm3 and its clearance volume is 40 cm3. Calculate the compression ratio.
items.s: Compression ratio = (swept + clearance)/clearance = (400 + 40)/40 = 11.

items.q: An engine has a compression ratio of 20 and a swept volume of 680 cm3. Calculate its clearance volume in cm3.
items.s: Clearance volume = swept volume/(compression ratio - 1) = 680/19 = 35.8 cm3.

items.q: A four stroke engine of 2.5 litre displacement develops 36 kW at 2400 revolutions per minute. Calculate the brake mean effective pressure in kPa.
items.s: bmep = 120000 x power/(displacement x speed) = 120000 x 36/(2.5 x 2400) = 720 kPa.

items.q: A tractor engine consumes 24 kg of diesel per hour while delivering 60 kW at the shaft. Calculate the specific fuel consumption in kg/kWh.
items.s: Specific fuel consumption = fuel used per hour/power = 24/60 = 0.4 kg/kWh.

items.q: An engine burns 5 kg of fuel per hour and the calorific value of the fuel is 44.5 MJ/kg. Calculate the heat energy released per hour expressed as a power in kW.
items.s: Fuel power = mass per hour x calorific value/3.6 = 5 x 44.5/3.6 = 61.8 kW.

items.q: A tractor pulls an implement with a draft of 7.5 kN at a forward speed of 8 km/h. Calculate the drawbar power in kW.
items.s: Drawbar power = draft x speed/3.6 = 7.5 x 8/3.6 = 16.67 kW.

items.q: A tractor wheel would cover 150 m in a given time if it rolled without slipping but it actually covers 130 m. Calculate the wheel slip in percent.
items.s: Slip = (theoretical distance - actual distance)/theoretical distance x 100 = (150 - 130)/150 x 100 = 13.3 percent.

items.q: A trailer of weight 18 kN runs on a soil whose coefficient of rolling resistance is 0.1. Calculate the rolling resistance in kN.
items.s: Rolling resistance = coefficient x weight = 0.1 x 18 = 1.8 kN.

items.q: The torque at the axle of a tractor wheel is 3000 N m and the rolling radius of the wheel is 0.8 m. Calculate the tractive force at the rim in N.
items.s: Tractive force = torque/radius = 3000/0.8 = 3750 N.

items.q: An engine turning at 1800 revolutions per minute drives through a gear ratio of 3.5. Calculate the speed of the output shaft in revolutions per minute.
items.s: Output speed = engine speed/gear ratio = 1800/3.5 = 514.3 revolutions per minute.

items.q: A gearbox receives 180 N m of torque from the engine and has a reduction ratio of 3. Calculate the torque at the output shaft in N m, taking the drive as ideal.
